one_line: Ahom king Suhungmung overseeing royal scribes as they carve the Snake Pillar inscription, anchoring court memory in stone.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic and upright, with the poised bearing of a warrior-king used to both battle and court ritual.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown Assamese complexion, straight nose, sharp but kind dark eyes with slightly arched brows, a thin neatly trimmed moustache and small goatee, default expression a calm, focused seriousness with a hint of pride.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair pulled back into a tight topknot at the back of the crown, sides neatly combed, no loose strands; he wears a plain, fitted white cloth headband tied at the back, with the knot and short tails visible above the nape.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, thigh-length off‑white cotton tunic (kurta-like) with a simple round neck and narrow long sleeves, the fabric plain but finely woven; over it a sleeveless, slightly fitted light‑indigo cotton coat reaching just below the hips, fastened with three narrow cloth ties down the front; around his waist a broad, handwoven red‑and‑white Assamese gamusa‑style sash wrapped twice and knotted at his left hip, the ends hanging to mid‑thigh with small woven geometric borders; his lower garment is a ankle‑length, tightly wrapped unpatterned deep‑mustard cotton dhoti/cheleng‑like cloth with soft pleats at the front; he wears simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop; jewellery is modest—a single narrow gold armlet on his right upper arm, small round gold ear studs, and a thin gold chain barely visible at his neck; overall the outfit is practical court attire suitable for moving between council and ritual sites.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved iron sword in a plain dark-brown wooden scabbard with minimal brass fittings, worn at his left side on a simple red cloth belt, plus a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript held in his left hand when not resting on the sword hilt.

ref_desc: Suhungmung is a medium-brown Assamese warrior-king in his forties with a neat moustache and goatee, black hair in a topknot with a white headband, wearing an off‑white tunic, light‑indigo sleeveless coat, red sash, mustard dhoti, brown sandals, and carrying a curved sword in a brown scabbard and a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript with accents of red, off‑white, blue, mustard and brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Ahom king Suhungmung in early 16th-century Upper Assam, shown as a dignified warrior-king overseeing scribes at the Snake Pillar: he has an oval face, medium-brown Assamese complexion, sharp dark eyes, a thin neatly trimmed moustache and small goatee, and straight black hair gathered into a tight topknot at the back of the crown, encircled by a plain white cloth headband tied with short tails at the back. His costume is a modest but regal court outfit: a long, thigh-length off‑white cotton tunic with a simple round neck and narrow long sleeves, over which he wears a sleeveless, slightly fitted light‑indigo cotton coat that reaches just below the hips and fastens with three narrow ties down the front; around his waist is a broad red-and-white gamusa-style woven sash wrapped twice and knotted at his left hip, the fringed ends hanging to mid‑thigh with subtle geometric borders. His lower garment is a tightly wrapped, ankle‑length deep‑mustard cotton dhoti or cheleng-like cloth with soft pleats at the front, and on his feet are simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop. Add restrained jewellery only: a narrow gold armlet on his right upper arm, small round gold ear studs, and a thin gold chain at his neck. His signature gear is a long, slightly curved iron sword in a plain dark-brown wooden scabbard with minimal brass fittings, hanging from a simple red cloth belt at his left side, while he also holds a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript in his left hand to connect him to the Ahom scribes and early epigraphy. Use a restrained palette of off‑white, light indigo blue, deep mustard yellow, red and brown, and present front, side, and back views clearly showing his face, topknot with white headband, layered garments, sash knot, sword position and sandals, in a clean, educational, family-safe style.
